description: Live Kubernetes observe and gated mutate tools (SteadyHelm).

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: List all Kubernetes namespaces in the cluster.

tools.name: list_pods
tools.description: List pods in a namespace, optionally filtered by label selector.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace. Leave empty for all namespaces.

tools.name: get_pod
tools.description: Get detailed status of a specific pod.

tools.name: get_pod_logs
tools.description: Fetch recent logs from a pod container.

container.description: Container name (optional, defaults to first container)

tail_lines.description: Number of log lines to return (default 100)

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List all nodes with their status, roles, and resource capacity.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List Kubernetes events, optionally filtered by namespace or field selector.

namespace.description: Namespace to query. Empty = all namespaces.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments with replica counts and rollout status.

namespace.description: Namespace to query. Empty = all namespaces.

tools.name: list_hpas
tools.description: List HorizontalPodAutoscalers with current/desired/min/max replica counts and metrics.

namespace.description: Namespace to query. Empty = all namespaces.

tools.name: list_pod_metrics
tools.description: List live CPU and memory usage for pods (requires metrics-server).

namespace.description: Namespace to query. Empty = all namespaces.

tools.name: list_node_metrics
tools.description: List live CPU and memory usage for nodes (requires metrics-server).

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Services with their type, cluster IP, and port mappings.

namespace.description: Namespace to query. Empty = all namespaces.

tools.name: get_configmap
tools.description: Read the data keys of a ConfigMap (values are shown).

tools.name: cluster_summary
tools.description: Return a concise health summary: node count/status, pod phase counts, recent Warning events, HPA saturation.

namespace.description: Scope summary to a namespace. Empty = cluster-wide.

tools.name: scale_deployment
tools.description: Scale a Deployment to the specified replica count. WRITE — requires readwrite mode.

tools.name: delete_pod
tools.description: Delete a pod by name (triggers restart). WRITE — requires readwrite mode.
